summary: Frontend-only validation completed for /investor on public preview URL. Existing four-step investor qualification flow remains functional, and the new right-side non-interactive MacBook product reel replaces the old signal-map showcase. Reel opens, auto-cycles all required industries in order, closes/reopens, and restarts at Finance. Responsive (1920x800 and 390x844), reduced-motion behavior, autoplay query wiring, and console cleanliness all passed.
action_items: No blocking issues found for the requested /investor MacBook-loop replacement scope.
Optional cleanup: remove legacy unused .investor-signal-map CSS block if codebase cleanup is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: InvestorProductLoop reel state machine correctly implements opening -> playing (industry cycle) -> closing -> closed -> restart.
MacBook showcase is properly non-interactive (pointer-events disabled in loop container and iframe), preventing form interaction conflicts.
Scenario payloads are centralized in scenarios.json and strict sandbox iframe content reflects scenario-specific values (validated samples: FINANCE/Meridian/KYC and LEGAL/Northstar/Vendor DPA).
Enterprise scenario data and outcomes are explicitly MOCKED simulations, consistent with product disclosure requirements.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated full ~31s investor reel and restart behavior, four-step qualification flow (Continue/Back/Skip), autoplay query persistence, absence of old signal-map UI in /investor DOM, no horizontal overflow on 1920x800 and 390x844, reduced-motion stable Finance/open-laptop state, and no console/runtime errors during tested paths.
rca of the issue: No product defects found in the requested scope. One intermediate automation check briefly flagged a potential legal scenario mismatch and placeholder-name text, but deeper iframe-content validation confirmed scenario data was correct; the initial flags were test-assertion sensitivity issues (case-sensitive match and broad placeholder heuristic), not app defects.
